events.reason: Upgraded the implementation of the (since retired) L1MessageQueue that gated all L1->L2 messages popped by ScrollChain at finalization.

Granted TIMELOCK_7DAY_DELAY_ROLE updateVerifier on eth:0xf94AfBD9370E25Dd6Ca557d5D67634aeFDA2416B, the verifier router ScrollChain used since the 2024-07-02 upgrade, opening the verifier update path for it.
Upgraded the implementation of the (since retired) L1MessageQueue that gated all L1->L2 messages popped by ScrollChain at finalization.

Registered ZkEvmVerifierV2-1 (eth:0xCAECeE2E815e7f758c2477f900AFA14bDDce54B3) as proof verifier version 4 and, in the same transaction, moved ownership of the MultipleVersionRollupVerifier from Scroll Multisig 3 to ScrollOwner, putting verifier updates behind the ScrollOwner timelock roles.
Granted DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE of the L2 ScrollOwner to the L2 TimelockFast (before L2 discovery coverage).
Granted DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE of ScrollOwner to TimelockFast (1 day delay, Scroll Multisig 3), a second admin path able to grant itself any role including core upgrades.

Introduced the Security Council setup: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to TimelockSCSlow, upgrade and verifier-update rights (SECURITY_COUNCIL_NO_DELAY_ROLE) from Scroll Multisig 3 to TimelockSCEmergency, the Scroll multisig no-delay and 1/7-day timelock roles revoked and replaced by ops-fast (TimelockFast) and emergency-nodelay (TimelockEmergency).

Introduced the Security Council setup on L2: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to the L2 TimelockSCSlow, L2 ProxyAdmin upgrade rights to TimelockSCEmergencyScroll, Scroll multisig and 1/7-day timelock roles revoked (before L2 discovery coverage).
Revoked DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE of ScrollOwner from TimelockFast, leaving the Security Council TimelockSCSlow as the only admin.
Revoked DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE of the L2 ScrollOwner from the L2 TimelockFast (before L2 discovery coverage).
Registered ZkEvmVerifierPostEuclid (eth:0x0112315Fa1c81c35ac9a477e161B52Ae4D1466B3) as proof verifier version 6 in the Euclid phase-1 upgrade transaction.
Registered eth:0x1dc65f7ab1964ec328f6249d1a68d0c1633a1357 as proof verifier version 7 in the Euclid phase-2 upgrade transaction.

Scroll Multisig 3, sole proposer, canceller and admin of TimelockFast, lowered its threshold from 4 to 3 of 5 while swapping one signer (signer count unchanged), a deliberate threshold policy change on the fast operations path.
The L2 Scroll Multisig 3, sole proposer, canceller and admin of the L2 TimelockFast, lowered its threshold from 4 to 3 of 5 while swapping one signer (signer count unchanged).
Replaced proof verifier version 7 with eth:0x33996CC9EEe2dc20B10b8E57d313d0FacC7a0828 for all batches.
Replaced proof verifier version 7 in the MultipleVersionRollupVerifier.

Moved updateEnforcedBatchParameters and updateMessageQueueParameters (SystemConfig) and updateFeeVault (L1ScrollMessenger) from ops-fast to SECURITY_COUNCIL_NO_DELAY_ROLE, removed updateMaxNumTxInChunk and updateMaxReplayTimes from ops-fast, and wired the PauseController.
Changed the AgoraGovernor voting delay from 86,400 to 3,600 blocks and voting period from 201,600 to 432,000 blocks.
Replaced proof verifier version 7 after a soundness bug and retained the preceding verifier as a legacy verifier.
Registered ZkEvmVerifierPostFeynman as proof verifier version 8.
Changed the AgoraGovernor voting delay from 3,600 to 172,800 blocks and voting period from 432,000 to 403,200 blocks.
Changed the AgoraGovernor voting delay from 172,800 to 129,600 blocks and voting period from 403,200 to 302,400 blocks.
Registered the Galileo proof verifiers for versions 9 and 10.
Replaced proof verifier version 10 after a guest prover bug.

Replaced the independent 9/12 Security Council Safe by the 3/4 ScrollAdminMultisig as admin, proposer, executor and canceller of TimelockSCEmergency, the 0-delay holder of SECURITY_COUNCIL_NO_DELAY_ROLE (core upgrades, verifier updates).

Replaced the independent 9/12 Security Council Safe (eth:0x1a37bF1Ccbf570C92FE2239FefaaAF861c2924DD) by the 3/4 ScrollAdminMultisig as admin, proposer, executor and canceller of TimelockSCSlow, the DEFAULT_ADMIN of ScrollOwner.
Replaced the 9/12 Security Council Safe by the 3/4 ScrollAdminMultisig as admin, proposer, executor and canceller of TimelockSCEmergencyScroll, the 0-delay upgrader of all L2 core contracts.
Moved the AgoraGovernor admin (voting delay and period, quorum, manager) from the 9/12 Security Council Safe to the 3/4 ScrollAdminMultisig.
Replaced the 9/12 Security Council Safe by the 3/4 ScrollAdminMultisig as admin, proposer, executor and canceller of the L2 TimelockSCSlow, the DEFAULT_ADMIN of the L2 ScrollOwner.
Registered ZkEvmVerifierPostFeynman (eth:0x808297224e86b1a6055B5F790a2cE07Ed611f955) as proof verifier version 10 in the MultipleVersionRollupVerifier.
Replaced proof verifier version 10 with ZkEvmVerifierPostFeynman (eth:0x7966FE0De13e3B81533470640Ac489223476B254).
